name: 2S LiPo pack 2200 mAh 25C
description: 2-cell lithium polymer pack, 7.4 V nominal (8.4 V full), 2.2 Ah, very high current capability.
notes: Voltage swings from 8.4 V (full) to 6 V (empty): every part on the battery must accept the FULL voltage.
The pack can deliver 55 A into a short. Always put a fuse right at the battery and a switch in series.
A bare LiPo has no protection: use a low-voltage alarm/cut-off or a BMS, and charge only with a balance charger.
Connector (XT60, Deans, JST) and the capacity and C rating vary: read your pack label.
Puffed, dented or hot packs must not be used.

pins.name: BAT+

pins.note: Full 8.4 V, nominal 7.4 V, never below 6 V (3.0 V per cell; 3.3 V per cell is kinder).
